Classic Chocolate Chip Cookies

Crispy edges, chewy centers. The perfect chocolate chip cookie recipe.

  • 2 1/4 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 cup unsalted butter, softened
  • 2 large eggs
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • 2 cups semi-sweet chocolate chips
24 cookies
Preheat oven to 375 degrees F.
Cream together butter and sugar until fluffy.
Mix in eggs and vanilla, then fold in flour and chocolate chips.
Drop rounded tablespoons onto baking sheets and bake for 9 to 11 minutes.
